content:
A posted incoming can be reversed only with sufficient current posted cash and no active source reservation. Reassignment then credits its full amount and moves its source quota.

No temporary overdraft facility is provided. Each correction is checked against the account balance at its execution time.

The cash available in an account need not equal the total nominal incoming records, because earlier unrelated debits and credits can also be present. Unrelated signed mandates remain enforceable.
